angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 306,108 km at 41.92 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 23.8571 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 41.92 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.44 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract): 306,108 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.44 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3759 +/- 87 K from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2095.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.795, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2095 (pscomppars): spectral type M2.5 V, from Murgas et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LSPM J1902+7525: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2095 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.24 dex, from Murgas et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2095 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.45892, from Murgas et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2095 (pscomppars): age 1 Gyr, from Murgas et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2095 (pscomppars): rotation period 40 d, from Murgas et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
